card.name: Inside acronyms like MATE and HITTS
card.fires_on: The middle piece of an acronym spelled out in brackets, mostly the ATE in (MATE) after "multidrug and toxin extrusion". Also the IT in HITTS and the middle of a species name like jirovecii.
